CustomField.description: Stages Mode only. Marks this page optional: its stage card shows an Optional badge and it does not count toward required progress. New stage records for it start as Optional. Changing it later does not update stage records already created. No effect in page-by-page forms.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this to mark the page optional in Stages Mode: its card shows an Optional badge and it is left out of the required progress count. Changing it later does not update stages already created on existing submissions.
CustomField.label: Is Optional
